perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Dragonfly

perks.name: Swashbuckler

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Vanguard Determination
perks.desc: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

perks.name: Wild Card
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 153 from 9 September 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6iEksMDGzT5euNuMAEqnVm?si=a9bf49987cdb441a) with @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for dealing with Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. As an adaptive frame SMG, Qua Nilus III is mid-tier for PvE damage output and has a bit of an unfocused pool of trait perks. The weapon stats look very good compared to its peers - and that's helped further at Tier 4/5 when bowstring and arrow perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/190747610 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. You can use pretty much any barrel perk to boost your preferred stat that doesn't apply a malus. In the magazine perk slot, look for an option to boost Reload Speed. Within the useful range of SMGs, CQC trait perks shine - in the first column, Proximity Power stacks up ×3 times to provide +15 (+18 when enhanced) to your Melee attribute per stack on kills when another enemy's within 15m - a total a +45 (+54) for a refreshable 10s on further kills, so you can invest stat points into other armour attributes. In the second column, for damage, there's either Surrounded which procs while within 15m of 3+ enemies to boost damage by up to ×1.4 (×1.47 enhanced), or use the melee stacks with Swashbuckler for up to ×5 stacks for ×1.33 damage on kills, with a melee kill giving 5 stacks, for a refreshable 4.5s (5s when enhanced). Another option would be to use melee stacks with an arc/solar/void melee to proc Binary Orbit to provide a ×1.25 damage boost for 8.5s (10.5s enhanced) on any elemental kill of the opposite type. The Vanguard Vindication Origin Trait provides up to 3 stacks of ×0.98/0.96/0.94 damage reduction for 10s, for kills within 20s of using a class ability. There's also the fun Wild Card for the chance of Telesto-like "Experimental Submunitions" dropping on a kill - the number depends on the enemy tier - that last up to 10.5s and explode on contact or proximity to an enemy. If you're interested, "Qua Nilus" is badly translated Latin for "Where the Nile" - maybe Cassoid needs to hire better translators in its marketing department. Recommended MW: any, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
